requirements.text: We’re looking for a senior software engineer with experience in early-stage or high-growth environments to join our team. As a foundational member of engineering, you’ll work directly with our founders to design, build, and launch new product features—from first lines of code to production. Every week, you’ll ship real functionality and have the autonomy to tackle meaningful, complex engineering problems.
Experience building and scaling high-quality, maintainable, products from the client to the server
Experience and interest in working across the stack

You enjoy building features, as well as designing and scaling architecture Nimble, hungry, humble, and adaptive to change You appreciate good design, and you get excited to translate that into functional experiences that people use every day

You are a human-centric product thinker who loves thinking about how technology can best be used to enhance people's lives
You are excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment
A true problem-solver and self-starter, with incredible ambition and drive
Competitive and highly motivated to exceed expectations
Ready to roll up your sleeves, get things done, and work harder than you’ve likely ever worked before, but with far greater reward
A fun, honest, empathetic, and curious teammate
You understand that Agentio is building in-person, 5 days a week
